text:
emma: quick flag - partner reported model returned a response that passed model checks but failed our structured schema and got routed to fallback; they were billed and confused.

raj: sample?

emma: logged payload (redacted): `{"op":"create","payload":["proj-42","Fix it"]}` - `payload` is array, schema expects object `{project_id, summary}`.

sofia: Router treats schema mismatch as enforce by default which explains fallback.

infra-bot: :warning: validation.mismatch rate 6/min on prod-2 (last 5m)

zoe: Proposal: add `validator.reason` to traces, and a per-request redacted hint in Console behind an org-level toggle (default off). Also expose `x-validate-mode` header with values `observe|soft|strict`.

raj: Soft mode = run validator + attempt conservative coercion (positional array->object when mapping explicit) but do not change routing; emit `validation.coercion_applied` metric.

sofia: Privacy: never show full payload unless org explicitly opts in; show only a short message like "schema mismatch: payload expected object, got array".

emma: Billing note: we bill for attempts; finance to propose credit policy for clear validator misclassification.

zoe: Action items: raj proto metrics + header, sofia mock Console hint + toggle, emma coordinate with finance. Sync in 30m.
